lines: Round 6 is being rendered by four agents since 20:21: the judged stills at the final tier · the motion sheets · the gate and the measures. Critics and jurors start when the pack is in at about 21:05

Sound while waiting: the lift has a kept take now (take 3: a heavy thing scraped across and lifted off stone) and the tick is the softer take 2. The winter shake cue is out of takes with none that fits (take 3 came back as sleigh bells alone) and stays silent: open item 37
The archive of the four kept sounds is attached
Round 7 freezes at 22:15 and is the last round of the look lock
phase 3: 12.30 h used of its 11.00 h box
allowance (before the review): 18.92 h used of 36.00 h allowed

pictures.caption: Frame 96 of the test shake at the review tier: the bloom that hides the change of season is now a warm glow with a small core. In Round 5 it was a white disc that came and went in three frames
The crown of the tree: the approved image on the left and the build on the right. The snow lies in broad blankets now and the foliage is still lighter and mossier than approved
